title: SEED-L06 create dispatches LOAN_CREATED onto submitted-and-pending-approval
_note: The SEED-L06 create command (loanId 6) leaves the loan in the oracle's null/INVALID status; the state machine's answer to LOAN_CREATED from there is SUBMITTED_AND_PENDING_APPROVAL (id 100, loanStatusType.submitted.and.pending.approval), the status the subsequent approve command's read-back transitively confirms. from_stored_value 0 is LoanStatus.INVALID, the only status LOAN_CREATED is dispatched from; loan.NextStatus special-cases it. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: capture_ref names the committed create command read-back for SEED-L06; the answer is the state machine's documented LOAN_CREATED arm pinned by the enum table.
